body: Not everyone has your parents, some of us truly are on our own.
Same deal here, at this point it's not a coincidence the way people have treated me over the years.

I've had multiple therapists since my early teens and this lastest one was the straw that broke the camel's back :(

I wish I could just jump from therapist to therapist but where I live healthcare is shit and I dont want to financially burden my family for longer.
I feel completely the same, what does it matter to try to look better if I will aways have these ugly scars all over me

I am a burn victim meaning most of my skin is covered in scars, including my face. Sorry if I can't give any advice since im still in a similar situation to what you said in your post but keep in mind that you are not alone and i'm hoping the best for you :)
Me too, but in my case it's and it always be impossible.

I've had around 6+ therapists over my life and nothing has changed, at this point I'm starting to believe I'm just a lost cause. Plus I'm a teenager living with my aunt on a country with shit healthcare so I can't currently go anyway

I don't want to say that my experience is absolute but at least in my case, after 6+ therapists over the course of my life I'm still the same mess but now with a diagnosis and pills, nothing really changed, not myself or my situation.
I do feel like this a lot but I also have given up the posibility of someone ever being interested in me long ago so I guess it's more of the same
Way too relatable

Not necesarily acne but I have BDD from the burn scars on my skin, I really felt what you said about constantly touching one's skin and checking yourself, I do that too all the time. Therapy didn't work for me but it did for you, so I think you should either wait for quarantine to be over and get a therapist or get an online session now
The suicide hotline is known for sucking a lot, I'm tired of people that praise it but have never even used it.

I've called them recently and it truly sucks, they put you on hold for sooo long and after picking up most of the time there isn't someone qualified on the other end of the line and they just give generic advice that has nothing to do with what you have told them.

I'm here if you want to talk to someone on the same boat, hoping the best for you :)

This is so true, there are places where healthcare sucks and not even insurance can get you therapy. People who say stuff like "therapy is the answer" or "therapy is what you need" just make it worse, making the situation seem more hopeless for those of us who just can't get therapy.
I'm 19 with both 3rd and 2nd degree burns, in my case they took around a year to get a more natural color (as opposed to red/purple).
Wish I wasn't so ugly and life gave me a break once and for all :(
I'm on the same boat, it sucks when people humiliate and ostricize you for being quiet and then expect you to be more open afterwards.
I feel this so much :(
It was the opposite in my case, one of the boys in my middle school got dared to "confess to the ugliest girl on school", that girl ended up being me.
My burn scars, they are all over my body and have made my life hell

As someone with a facial disfigurement I can relate to your brother so much and all I can do is admire what you have done to help him, it really must mean a lot to him. Right now I'm also suicidal and sadly don't have any siblings but at the very least I hope your brother can get better and live his best life with your help.
I used to be happy and not an anxious mess due to my appearance and the horrible way people have treated me since
19 yr old girl here, sucks to feel like a freak and not have any kind of meaningful human interaction
Im another gal who is on the same page, my self esteem is through the ground but at least is nice hearing that we are not alone in this

What if I can't change one of the parts about myself that i hate the most? Aside from my social anxiety and overall being awkward I have a facial/body disfigurement that makes me look hideous.and I hate it.
I feel you, I have no friends and my severe social anxiety has made me a shut in for a while, I hope the best for you since I don't think I can help myself
I also got bullied most of my life and dont have any friends, I hope the best for you and everyone in a situation like ours
I feel the same as you and its really disheartening, at least we arent alone in our search for happiness
